mutations.name: the posted op drops the owner's wait for the adversary loop
kills: inbox owner-op merge-at-head on a g10-held PR approves now and posts the wait for the adversary loop at the previewed head, reading approved as landed

mutations.name: the wait is offered on a PR with no g10 hold
mutations.find: if (!held) return `${facts.repo}#${facts.pr} holds no g10 hold, so there is no adversary loop to wait for; merge at head instead`;
kills: inbox owner-op merge-at-head on a g10-held PR offers no wait on a PR with no g10 hold

mutations.name: the forced merge on a g10-held PR reads back as a plain merge
kills: inbox owner-op merge-at-head on a g10-held PR reads the forced merge back as skipping the hold and posts it with no wait

mutations.name: the act re-reads the read-back without the owner's wait
mutations.find: const readBack = await readBackOf(ctx.sources, item, action, tap.waitFor);
mutations.replace: const readBack = await readBackOf(ctx.sources, item, action);
kills: inbox owner-op merge-at-head on a g10-held PR approves now and posts the wait for the adversary loop at the previewed head, reading approved as landed

mutations.name: a standing approval reads as a queued land run
mutations.find: return "Merge approved: Shepherd merges at this head once the adversary loop closes with MERGE; a new head or a non-MERGE verdict voids it and the inbox tells you";
mutations.replace: return `Merge queued: land run ${outcome.runId} merges at this head once its checks are green`;
kills: inbox owner-op merge-at-head on a g10-held PR approves now and posts the wait for the adversary loop at the previewed head, reading approved as landed
